integrity_statement: The proof is analytic. The standalone exact rational tests are supplementary; source priority remains subject to independent specialist literature checks.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted connected complete multipartite graph Laplacians; exact final-step maps only. The bounded scalar-filter converse and complete multipartite structure are essential; the four-vertex path is a counterexample outside the family. No claim of internal-stage positivity, nonlinear extension, floating-point positivity, or L-stability.
title: A scalar criterion for unconditionally positive rational graph-heat steps on complete multipartite networks
